name: Chinese Money Plant
hook: Pilea growing tall and thin? It needs more light.

steps.title: Bright, indirect light
steps.tip: Set it back from a bright window or behind a sheer curtain. Direct summer sun scorches the round leaves.

steps.title: Water when top 2 cm is dry
steps.tip: Water until it drains through, and never leave it standing in water. Pilea is prone to root rot.

steps.title: Normal room temperatures
steps.tip: Keep it at 18–24°C by day and above 13°C at night, away from drafts, vents and heaters.

steps.title: Pot up the baby plants
steps.tip: Separate the baby plants that pop up around the base and pot them on their own: free plants for friends.

steps.title: Go up 5 cm at a time
steps.tip: Repot into fast-draining, peat-free houseplant mix, in a pot about 5 cm wider than the root ball.

steps.title: Keep the leaves dry
steps.tip: Water the soil, not the leaves, to avoid leaf spot, and check for mites, mealybugs and fungus gnats.

outro: Bright, indirect light and careful watering, then share the babies.
